source_sha_policy: The deployed commit SHA is preserved by the provider deployment record and immutable fallback proxy.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; response analysis distinguishes engagement, discussion, external framing and verified owner exports; raw commenter identity is minimized.

release_intent: Publish the current canonical homepage and all critical surfaces as a richer, more personal, visually varied and functionally intact Igor Vepretski experience.
rollback: Provider deployment history and previous source commits remain available for rollback.
